fixed_runtime_guidance: The Agent must output one legal PolicyDecision at a time. Follow the action schema and use only references visible in the current state.
fixed_answer_contract: The final answer must be supported by legal evidence. Never guess, fabricate, or add claims that the evidence does not support.

retrieval_policy.title: Start from the current question
retrieval_policy.when: No useful evidence is currently visible.
action_sequence: Use SEARCH to identify the main entity, relation, or requested attribute.
Choose the target that matches the question's requested level of detail.
retrieval_policy.stop_or_recovery: Inspect the returned material before choosing the next action.

retrieval_policy.title: Use a sentence when it already answers the question
retrieval_policy.when: A visible Sentence directly states the requested fact and covers the question's conditions.
action_sequence: Check the subject, relation, and requested answer level.
Use FINISH with the smallest legal evidence set.
retrieval_policy.stop_or_recovery: Do not retrieve more material after all answer conditions are covered.
exceptions: Continue when a multi-hop question still lacks evidence for another hop.

retrieval_policy.title: Read a useful visible chunk
retrieval_policy.when: A visible unread Chunk may contain the missing fact and no complete Sentence is yet sufficient.
action_sequence: READ the most relevant unread Chunk.
Inspect the newly visible Sentences before another SEARCH.
retrieval_policy.stop_or_recovery: FINISH when the newly visible legal evidence covers the question; otherwise change the missing part of the search.

retrieval_policy.title: Resolve a bridge before the next hop
retrieval_policy.when: The question needs two or more facts and the current evidence identifies an intermediate entity or relation.
action_sequence: EXPAND or READ the visible source that can identify the intermediate entity.
SEARCH for the remaining attribute only after the bridge is explicit.
retrieval_policy.stop_or_recovery: FINISH only after every required hop has legal supporting evidence.
exceptions: Skip expansion when the question or visible evidence already names the intermediate entity unambiguously.

recovery_policy.title: Change path after no progress
recovery_policy.when: The last SEARCH or EXPAND did not add useful information for the missing part of the question.
action_sequence: Check for an unread Chunk or expandable visible source.
Use READ or EXPAND when one is available.
Otherwise change the searched entity, attribute, target, or method.
recovery_policy.stop_or_recovery: Do not repeat a semantically equivalent SEARCH without a changed target or missing fact.

recovery_policy.title: Avoid repeated actions
recovery_policy.when: The previous action was duplicate, invalid, or returned only material already visible.
action_sequence: Choose a different legal path that can add information.
recovery_policy.stop_or_recovery: FINISH when existing legal evidence is sufficient; otherwise keep the next action different in purpose.

recovery_policy.title: Keep a finishing opportunity
recovery_policy.when: Legal evidence covers all requested conditions or the remaining budget is small.
action_sequence: FINISH with a concise supported answer when possible.
recovery_policy.stop_or_recovery: Do not spend the last policy attempts on another search when a legal answer can already be formed.
exceptions: Continue only when a required condition is visibly unsupported.

answer_policy.title: Answer from legal evidence
answer_policy.when: FINISH is legal and the selected evidence covers the question.
action_sequence: Extract the requested answer from the cited evidence.
Preserve required dates, people, relations, and comparison conditions.
Keep the answer direct and concise.
answer_policy.stop_or_recovery: Do not add content that the legal evidence does not support.
